about: Generations of the Fig. 12 rides computed on Kaggle, newest last. The page plays the newest; older ones are kept for the record.

generations.note: over-damped (damping ratio 0.10 to 0.14 after the last bump): glass faces held at zero velocity, a no-slip wall one cell thick; kept for the record, with the free-swing tests of solver v2
Taichi: ghost-fluid surface, free-slip glass faces, the Fig. 12 note's wall and foam friction; played by the page until 13 November 2026, evening; kept for the record

runs.what: the three rides with the speed held only, and the free swings with and without the head
the same roads with the site's controllers in the loop: joint control on all three, slosh LQR and road preview on the kerb

generations.note: JAX (tools/fig12/kaggle/stout_jax.py): APIC particles on a 1.5 mm grid, the head of foam as a sheet with its weight, yield stress and wall friction, the cart and its controllers coupled both ways; played by the page until 14 November 2026, kept for the record (the head had weight but no mass)

generations.solver: jax, the head with its mass

runs.what: the pint at rest, the free swing with the head (the controllers' plant, measured in the run: 2.915 Hz, damping ratio 0.425), the three roads with the speed held and with joint control, the kerb with the slosh LQR; books checked in every stored frame
the kerb with the road preview, computed alone after run 8's budget ran out, with run 8's plant
the free swing without the head (no head, so the head's mass cannot change it), packed again into this folder

generations.note: JAX (tools/fig12/kaggle/stout_jax.py) with the head's mass in the pressure step (a Robin condition; the note's eqs. 15a, 15b, 18a); played by the page until 14 November 2026 (run 10)

generations.solver: jax, the head with its mass; controllers with beta corrected for it

runs.what: the pint at rest and the five controlled rides (joint control on the three roads; slosh LQR and road preview on the kerb), the controllers designed on run 8's measured swing (2.915 Hz, damping ratio 0.425) with beta 1.541/1.242 = 1.241, gains K = (71.121, -1228.717, -40.499, -150.000); books checked in every stored frame; ALL PASS (notes/fig12/jax/run10-check/)
the three roads with the speed held and the free swing with the head, packed again into this folder
the free swing without the head, packed again into this folder

generations.note: JAX (tools/fig12/kaggle/stout_jax.py, run_b.py RUNSET=run10, BETA_HEAD); played by the page
